references.text: Israel committed spiritual adultery by following other gods, breaking the covenant they had made with God at Sinai.
Moses prophesied that after his death, the people would commit spiritual adultery with foreign gods.
Gideon made an ephod that all Israel followed into spiritual adultery, an example of idolatry during the time of the judges.
After Gideon's death, the Israelites turned away and committed spiritual adultery with the Baal gods.
Hosea describes Israel's unfaithfulness to God as spiritual adultery.
The people quickly turned aside from the way God had commanded them by making the golden calf.
God said that the people had quickly turned away from the way He had commanded them.
The curse that comes upon those who do not listen to God's commands and follow other gods.
The psalm describes how Israel mixed with the nations and worshiped their idols.
Ezekiel rebukes Israel for committing spiritual adultery after the detestable practices of their fathers.
